faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do Storage Add-ons change my subscription tier?
faq.a1: No. Storage add-ons simply expand your storage quota while keeping all features and credit limits of your current plan intact.
faq.q2: Are all AI translation and dubbing features available in the Free plan?
faq.a2: Yes! All VidNova AI features (translation, voice dubbing, diarization, subtitle editor) are fully accessible to every user.
faq.q3: How are AI Processing Credits calculated?
faq.a3: 1 minute of video speech processing typically consumes 1 credit. Your monthly credits reset automatically at the beginning of each billing cycle.
